items.rationale: Single-pass unquote in _normalize_requested_path lets double-encoded traversal payloads (e.g. %252e%252e%252f) survive normalization, bypassing the '..' segment check. Replaced with repeated unquote until stable so all encoding layers are peeled before validation.
AppSec confirmed exploit reproduces through encoded separators and symlink escapes. The repeated-unquote fix neutralizes encoded traversal while keeping nested exports under the tenant root intact.
JWT key rotation is a separate concern; AppSec explicitly instructed not to fold it into this hotfix. Will address in a follow-up release.
AppSec review notes to rotate JWT material later; out of scope for this path-traversal hotfix.
